name: add_to_blocklist
title: Add to suppression list
description: Add a recipient address to a suppression list, so messages sent with that list id are not delivered to it. Needs the account the block was raised for.

listId.description: List ID. Must use a subdomain name format. Lists are registered ad-hoc, so a new identifier defines a new list.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

recipient.description: Email address to add to the list

name: autodiscover_settings
title: Discover mail server settings
description: Discover the IMAP and SMTP server settings for an email address from DNS and the provider's autoconfiguration. The natural first step before create_account or verify_account_settings for a mailbox that does not use an OAuth2 application.

email.description: Email address to discover email settings for

name: cancel_queued_message
title: Cancel queued message
description: Cancel a message waiting in the sending queue, by the queue id from get_outbox. A message already handed to the mail server cannot be cancelled.

name: check_delivery_test
title: Check delivery test
description: Check the result of a delivery test started over the REST API: whether the probe message arrived, and its SPF, DKIM and DMARC results.

name: create_account
title: Create account
description: Register an email account. For an OAuth2 provider set oauth2.provider to the application id (from list_oauth2_apps) and oauth2.authorize to true: the response carries a redirect URL for the user to open and sign in, and no credentials are needed. For IMAP set imap and smtp with the host, port and auth the user supplied (autodiscover_settings finds the servers). Prefer create_account_setup_link when the user can open a link themselves, so no password passes through this conversation.

account.description: Account ID. If set to `null`, a unique ID will be generated automatically

email.description: Default email address of the account

expectedEmail.description: Pins the account to an email address

path.description: Mailbox folders to monitor for changes (IMAP only). Use "*" to monitor all folders (default)

items.description: Mailbox paths to monitor for changes. Use folder names, special-use flags like "\Sent", or "*" for all folders. Set to null to reset to default.

subconnections.description: Additional mailbox paths to monitor with dedicated IMAP connections for faster change detection. Use sparingly as connection limits are strict.

notifyFrom.description: Only send webhooks for messages received after this date. Defaults to account creation time. IMAP only.

imapIndexer.description: Override the global IMAP indexing strategy for this account. "full" - Track every change, including deletions. Slower but complete; "fast" - Detect new messages only. Cheaper, but deletions and flag changes are missed

imap.description: IMAP configuration. Set to `false` when there is no IMAP access to configure.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server to retrieve credentials dynamically

auth.description: Authentication credentials for the IMAP server

user.description: Username or email address for IMAP authentication

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (when using OAuth2 instead of password authentication)

secure.description: Use TLS encryption for the connection (true for port 993, false for STARTTLS on port 143)

rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject connections to servers with invalid TLS certificates

disableIMAP4rev2.description: Do not use IMAP4rev2 even if the server supports it

resyncDelay.description: Delay in seconds between full mailbox resynchronizations

disabled.description: Temporarily disable IMAP operations for this account

port.description: IMAP server port (typically 993 for IMAP over TLS, 143 for STARTTLS)

sentMailPath.description: Custom folder path for sent messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Sent" folder. Set to null to use default.

draftsMailPath.description: Custom folder path for draft messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Drafts" folder. Set to null to use default.

junkMailPath.description: Custom folder path for spam/junk messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Junk" folder. Set to null to use default.

trashMailPath.description: Custom folder path for deleted messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Trash" folder. Set to null to use default.

archiveMailPath.description: Custom folder path for archived messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Archive" folder. Set to null to use default.

smtp.description: SMTP configuration. Set to `false` when there is no SMTP access to configure.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server to retrieve credentials dynamically

auth.description: Authentication credentials for the SMTP server

user.description: Username or email address for SMTP authentication

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (when using OAuth2 instead of password authentication)

port.description: SMTP server port (typically 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SMTP over TLS, 25 for unencrypted)

secure.description: Use TLS encryption from the start (true for port 465, false for STARTTLS on ports 587/25)

rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject connections to servers with invalid TLS certificates

oauth2.description: OAuth2 configuration. Set to `false` when the account does not authenticate with OAuth2.

authorize.description: Request an OAuth2 authorization URL instead of directly configuring credentials

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect to after OAuth2 authorization completes (only used when authorize=true)

provider.description: OAuth2 Application ID configured in EmailEngine

delegatedAccount.description: Account ID to use for authenticating the shared mailbox. When provided, EmailEngine uses this account's credentials instead of creating new ones.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server for token management instead of EmailEngine

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token for the email account

refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token for obtaining new access tokens

name: create_account_setup_link
title: Create account setup link
description: Create a one-time link to the hosted setup form, where the user signs in to their mailbox themselves, so no password passes through this conversation. Give the link to the user. Set redirectUrl to where they should land afterwards; optionally account (the id to assign), name, email, expectedEmail (the setup is refused if they sign in as someone else) and type (an OAuth2 application id, or imap).

account.description: Account ID. If set to `null`, a unique ID will be generated automatically

email.description: Specifies the default email address for this account. Users can change it if needed.

expectedEmail.description: Pins the account to an email address

redirectUrl.description: After the authentication process is completed, the user is redirected to this URL

type.description: Pre-select a specific account type (use "imap" or an OAuth2 app ID) instead of showing the selection screen

name: create_draft
title: Create draft
description: Store a new message in a folder, typically a draft in the Drafts folder. Takes structured fields (from, to, subject, text, html). It takes the same `reference` block as send_message, so a reply or a forward can be drafted for the user to look over first. Nothing is sent - use send_message for that.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

reference.description: Reply to or forward a stored message. EmailEngine fills in the subject, the recipients and the In-Reply-To/References headers from the referenced message, and flags it as answered or forwarded once the new message is sent, so only the new content has to be supplied

message.description: EmailEngine message ID to reply to or forward

action.description: What to do with the referenced message. "forward" - Forward the message to new recipients; "reply" - Reply to the sender; "reply-all" - Reply to the sender and every other recipient

inline.description: Quote the referenced message under the new text, the way an email client does. Without it only the new text is sent

forwardAttachments.description: Carry the attachments of the referenced message over to the forwarded copy. Only valid when action is "forward"

ignoreMissing.description: Continue sending even if the referenced message cannot be found

messageId.description: Verify the Message-ID of the referenced email matches this value before proceeding

threadId.description: Gmail thread ID to attach the outgoing message to

name.description: Display name for the email address

items.description: Email address with optional display name

name.description: Display name for the email address

items.description: Email address with optional display name

name.description: Display name for the email address

items.description: Email address with optional display name

name.description: Display name for the email address

contentDisposition.description: "inline" - Rendered inside the message body, referenced by a cid: URL; "attachment" - Offered as a downloadable file

reference.description: References an existing attachment by its ID instead of providing new attachment content

name: create_gateway
title: Create SMTP gateway
description: Register an SMTP gateway, a relay server messages can be sent through. Needs an id, a name, the host and the port; a password can be written but never read back.

secure.description: Should connection use TLS. Usually true for port 465

name: create_oauth2_app
title: Create OAuth2 application
description: Register an OAuth2 application that accounts can sign in through. Needs the provider and the client credentials created at that provider; a client secret or service key can be written but never read back. Confirm the redirect URL with the user: it is where the provider sends authorization codes and has to match what the provider has on file.

name.description: Display name for the OAuth2 application

title.description: Short title shown on the OAuth2 button

provider.description: OAuth2 provider type. "gmail" - Gmail and Google Workspace, using a user-consented OAuth2 flow; "gmailService" - Google Workspace using a service account, with no per-user consent screen; "outlook" - Outlook and Microsoft 365, using a user-consented OAuth2 flow; "outlookService" - Microsoft 365 using application permissions, with no per-user consent screen; "mailRu" - Mail.ru

enabled.description: Whether this OAuth2 app is active

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID from the provider

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret from the provider

pubSubApp.description: Pub/Sub application ID for Gmail push notifications

googleWorkspaceAccounts.description: Restrict OAuth2 login to Google Workspace accounts only

googleTopicName.description: Google Pub/Sub topic name for Gmail push notifications

serviceKey.description: Service account private key in PEM format

authMethod.description: How token requests for the Gmail service account are signed. "serviceKey" - Sign token requests with an uploaded service account key; "externalAccount" - Sign token requests through Workload Identity Federation, with no key to store

externalAccount.description: Google external_account credential JSON for Workload Identity Federation

authority.description: Microsoft tenant configuration (common, organizations, consumers, or tenant ID)

cloud.description: Microsoft Azure cloud environment. "global" - The worldwide Azure cloud, used by most tenants; "gcc-high" - US Government Community Cloud High; "dod" - US Department of Defense cloud; "china" - Azure operated by 21Vianet in China

redirectUrl.description: OAuth2 redirect URI configured in the provider

name: create_template
title: Create template
description: Create a stored email template: a subject and body (html, text, previewText) that send_message can reference by id. account names the account the template belongs to.

account.description: Account ID. Use `null` for public templates.

previewText.description: Preview text shown in email clients after the subject line

name: delete_account
title: Delete account
description: Remove an account from this instance, with its synced index and the tokens bound to it. The mailbox at the provider is untouched. Set revoke to true to also revoke the OAuth2 grant at the provider. Confirm with the user before calling this.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

revoke.description: Revoke the upstream OAuth2 grant at the provider before deleting the account

name: delete_account_templates
title: Delete all templates of an account
description: Remove every stored template of one account. Requires force to be true. Confirm with the user before calling this.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

force.description: Must be true in order to flush templates

annotations.title: Delete all templates of an account

name: delete_gateway
title: Delete SMTP gateway
description: Remove an SMTP gateway. Messages queued through it fail to deliver. Confirm with the user before calling this.

name: delete_message
title: Delete message
description: Delete one message. It is moved to Trash when possible, and deleted permanently when it already is in Trash.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

force.description: Delete message even if not in Trash. Not supported for Gmail API accounts.

name: delete_oauth2_app
title: Delete OAuth2 application
description: Remove an OAuth2 application. Accounts that signed in through it can no longer refresh their access tokens and stop syncing. Confirm with the user before calling this.

name: delete_template
title: Delete template
description: Remove a stored template.

name: flush_account
title: Flush and re-sync account
description: Discard the account's local index and sync it again from scratch. Every existing message counts as new again, so webhooks fire for all of them; use only when the index is broken or the sync settings changed. Confirm with the user before calling this.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

notifyFrom.description: Only send webhooks for messages received after this date. Defaults to account creation time. IMAP only.

imapIndexer.description: Override the global IMAP indexing strategy for this account. "full" - Track every change, including deletions. Slower but complete; "fast" - Detect new messages only. Cheaper, but deletions and flag changes are missed

name: get_account
title: Get account
description: Get one account: its display name, email address, connection state and sync status. Credentials are masked.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

quota.description: If true, then include quota information in the response

name: get_account_logs
title: Get account connection log
description: Read the stored connection log of an account: the raw IMAP or provider API trace, which names folders, message ids and subjects. Use it to find out why an account fails to connect or sync. Only kept while logging is enabled for the account or for the whole instance.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

name: get_attachment
title: Get attachment
description: Download one attachment, returned inline as a base64 resource. The attachment id comes from the attachments list of get_message. Fails above 1 MB - larger files have to be fetched over the REST API.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

name: get_blocklist
title: Get suppression list
description: List the addresses on one suppression list, paged, with the reason and source of each entry.

listId.description: List ID. Must use a subdomain name format. Lists are registered ad-hoc, so a new identifier defines a new list.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: get_gateway
title: Get SMTP gateway
description: Get one SMTP gateway: host, port, TLS mode, username and the last delivery error. The password is masked.

name: get_instance_stats
title: Get instance statistics
description: Get instance-wide statistics: the running version, the license, how many accounts are connected, disconnected or failing, and message and webhook counters for the last `seconds` (default one day). The first call to make when asked how the instance is doing.

name: get_license
title: Get license
description: Get the active license: who it is issued to and when it expires, or an empty object when the instance runs unlicensed.

name: get_message
title: Get message
description: Get one message: subject, addresses, date, flags, attachment list and the body. The body arrives in text.html as sanitized HTML, generated from the plaintext part when the message carries no HTML one, with no separate plaintext copy. It is capped at 32768 characters - text.hasMore true means more of it is available from get_message_text. Quoted reply and forward history is wrapped in a <details class="ee-collapsed-thread"> element - what an email client hides behind a "show more" control - so everything outside it is what the sender wrote this time.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

markAsSeen.description: If true, then marks unseen email as seen while returning the message

name: get_message_text
title: Get message text
description: Fetch the body of a message as sanitized HTML, generated from the plaintext part when the message carries no HTML one. The text id comes from the text.id field of get_message or list_messages. It is capped at 65536 characters - hasMore true means the body is longer than that. Quoted reply and forward history is wrapped in a <details class="ee-collapsed-thread"> element - what an email client hides behind a "show more" control - so everything outside it is what the sender wrote this time.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

name: get_oauth2_app
title: Get OAuth2 application
description: Get one OAuth2 application: its provider, client id, scopes, redirect URL and Pub/Sub settings. Client secrets are masked.

name: get_outbox
title: List outbox
description: List messages queued for delivery, paged, including scheduled sends and their delivery progress.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: get_pubsub_status
title: Get Gmail Pub/Sub status
description: List the Gmail Pub/Sub push subscriptions of the OAuth2 applications and their state, paged. A Gmail account falls back to polling while its subscription is missing.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: get_queue
title: Get queue state
description: Get the state of a job queue: whether it is paused and how many jobs are active, waiting and delayed. `notify` carries webhook deliveries, `submit` carries outbound mail.

name: get_settings
title: Get settings
description: Read instance settings. Set each setting you want returned to true. Secrets come back as a boolean saying whether a value is stored, credentials inside URLs are masked, and eventTypes lists the webhook event names the instance supports. Settings that would widen this credential (operator scripts, proxies, secrets, the built-in listeners) are not offered.

name: get_token
title: Get access token
description: Get one access token by its id (from list_tokens): scopes, permissions, restrictions and last use. Never the token value itself.

token.description: The token id, as reported by POST /v1/tokens and the token listing

name: get_token_log
title: Get access token audit log
description: Read the audit log of one access token, paged: which requests it made, against which account, from which address, and which were refused and why. Only kept while the tokenAuditLog setting is on.

token.description: The token id, as reported by POST /v1/tokens and the token listing

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: get_webhook_route
title: Get webhook route
description: Get one webhook route: its target URL, the events it forwards, whether it is enabled, and its filter and mapping functions.

name: list_accounts
title: List accounts
description: List the email accounts on this instance, paged. Use the returned account id as the account argument of the other tools. Check the state field: only connected accounts can be read.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

state.description: Filter accounts by state. "init" - The account was just registered and has not connected yet; "unset" - The account is not syncing: either no IMAP or OAuth2 configuration is set, or syncing was switched off - by the operator, or automatically after repeated authentication failures; "connected" - Connected and watching for changes. This is the healthy steady state; "connecting" - Connecting to the mail server or authorizing with the provider; "syncing" - Connected and performing the initial or a periodic mailbox sync; "authenticationError" - The credentials were rejected. Requires re-authentication before syncing resumes; "connectError" - The server could not be reached or the TLS handshake failed. Retried with backoff; "disconnected" - The connection dropped and EmailEngine is retrying with backoff; "paused" - Syncing was paused through the API. No connection is maintained

name: list_blocklists
title: List suppression lists
description: List the suppression lists (blocklists) and how many addresses each holds, paged.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: list_gateways
title: List SMTP gateways
description: List the SMTP gateways (relay servers messages can be sent through instead of the account's own SMTP server), paged. Passwords are masked.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: list_mailboxes
title: List mailboxes
description: List the folders of an account with message counts and special-use roles (Inbox, Sent, Trash and so on). Folder paths from here are what list_messages, search_messages and move_message take.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

counters.description: If true, then includes message counters in the response

name: list_messages
title: List messages
description: List messages in one mailbox folder, newest first, paged. The folder path comes from list_mailboxes.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

path.description: Mailbox folder path. Can use special use labels like "\Sent". Special value "\All" is available for Gmail IMAP, Gmail API, MS Graph API accounts.

page.description: Page number (zero-indexed, so use 0 for the first page). Only supported for IMAP accounts

name: list_oauth2_apps
title: List OAuth2 applications
description: List the OAuth2 applications (Gmail, Outlook and other providers) that accounts can sign in through, paged. Client secrets are masked.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: list_templates
title: List templates
description: List stored email templates, paged. Pass an account id for account-specific templates or omit it for shared ones.

account.description: Account ID to list the templates for

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: list_tokens
title: List access tokens
description: List the access tokens on this instance, paged: description, scopes, restrictions, the account each is bound to and when it was last used. Token values are never shown. Filter with query, or with account for the tokens bound to one account.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

query.description: Filter by description, id or account

account.description: Only list tokens bound to this account. Omit to list every token on the instance

name: list_webhook_routes
title: List webhook routes
description: List the custom webhook routes, paged: per-route targets with their own event filters, beside the global webhook target in the settings. Credentials in target URLs are masked.

page.description: Page number (zero indexed, so use 0 for first page)

name: move_message
title: Move message
description: Move one message to another folder. The target folder path comes from list_mailboxes.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

source.description: Source mailbox folder path (Gmail API only). Needed to remove the label from the message.

name: reconnect_account
title: Reconnect account
description: Ask the account's worker to close and re-open its connection. Use after fixing credentials or server settings, or when an account is stuck connecting.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

name: remove_from_blocklist
title: Remove from suppression list
description: Remove a recipient address from a suppression list, so messages to it are delivered again.

listId.description: List ID. Must use a subdomain name format. Lists are registered ad-hoc, so a new identifier defines a new list.

recipient.description: Email address to remove from the list

name: revoke_token
title: Revoke access token
description: Revoke an access token by its id. Every client using it is cut off immediately and there is no undo. Confirm with the user before calling this.

token.description: The access token value, or the token id from a listing

name: search_messages

name: send_message
title: Send message
description: Send an email from the account to real recipients - confirm with the user before calling this. Takes structured fields (to, subject, text, html). To answer or pass on a message the user is looking at, set `reference.message` to its id and `reference.action` to reply, reply-all or forward, and write only the new text: the subject, the recipients (for a reply) and the threading headers come from the referenced message. Delivery is queued; the response carries the queue id for get_outbox.

forwardAttachments.description: Carry the attachments of the referenced message over to the forwarded copy. Only valid when action is "forward"

ignoreMissing.description: Continue sending even if the referenced message cannot be found

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (when using OAuth2 instead of password authentication)

secure.description: Use TLS encryption from the start

rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject connections to servers with invalid TLS certificates

oauth2.description: OAuth2 configuration. Set to `false` to remove the stored OAuth2 configuration from the account.

partial.description: Update only the provided fields instead of replacing the entire configuration

authorize.description: Request an OAuth2 authorization URL instead of directly configuring credentials

provider.description: OAuth2 Application ID configured in EmailEngine

delegatedAccount.description: Account ID to use for authenticating the shared mailbox. When provided, EmailEngine uses this account's credentials instead of creating new ones.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server for token management instead of EmailEngine

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token for the email account

refreshToken.description: OAuth2 refresh token for obtaining new access tokens

name: update_gateway
title: Update SMTP gateway
description: Update an SMTP gateway. Send only the fields to change. Changing the host makes the next delivery authenticate to the new host with the stored password, so confirm host changes with the user.

secure.description: Should connection use TLS. Usually true for port 465

name: update_message
title: Update message flags
description: Update the flags or labels of one message, e.g. add \Seen to mark it read or \Flagged to star it.

account.description: Unique identifier for the email account

add.description: Flags to add to the message

delete.description: Flags to remove from the message

set.description: Replace all flags with this list

add.description: Gmail labels to add (use label ID or path)

delete.description: Gmail labels to remove (use label ID or path)

name: update_oauth2_app
title: Update OAuth2 application
description: Update an OAuth2 application. Send only the fields to change; a client secret can be replaced but not read back. Changing the redirect URL moves where the provider sends authorization codes, so confirm that with the user.

clientId.description: Client or Application ID for 3-legged OAuth2 applications

pubSubApp.description: Cloud Pub/Sub app for Gmail API webhooks

skipScopes.description: OAuth2 scopes to skip from the base set

serviceClient.description: Service client ID for 2-legged OAuth2 applications

googleWorkspaceAccounts.description: Restrict OAuth2 login to Google Workspace accounts only

googleTopicName.description: Google Pub/Sub topic name for Gmail push notifications

serviceClientEmail.description: Service Client Email for 2-legged OAuth2 applications

serviceKey.description: PEM formatted service secret for 2-legged OAuth2 applications

authority.description: Authorization tenant value for Outlook OAuth2 applications

cloud.description: Azure cloud type for Outlook OAuth2 applications. "global" - The worldwide Azure cloud, used by most tenants; "gcc-high" - US Government Community Cloud High; "dod" - US Department of Defense cloud; "china" - Azure operated by 21Vianet in China

name: update_settings
title: Update settings
description: Change instance settings. Send only the keys to change; they take effect immediately on every worker. Covers where webhooks are delivered and which events are sent, notification shaping, the service URL and branding, sync strategy, queue retention, AI processing and TLS provisioning. Confirm with the user before changing the webhook target, the service URL or the TLS mode. The settings that would widen this credential (operator scripts, proxies, secrets, the built-in listeners, the MCP and audit switches) are not offered.

webhooksEnabled.description: Enable or disable webhook delivery for all accounts

webhooks.description: Target URL that will receive webhook notifications via POST requests

webhookEvents.description: List of event types that will trigger webhook notifications

notifyHeaders.description: Email headers to include in webhook payloads for additional context

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of this EmailEngine instance (used for generating public URLs, path component is ignored)

notificationBaseUrl.description: Public callback URL for external OAuth providers. Falls back to serviceUrl if not set

trackClicks.description: Rewrite links in outgoing HTML emails to track click-through rates

trackOpens.description: Insert a tracking pixel in outgoing HTML emails to detect when messages are opened

imapIndexer.description: How much of a mailbox EmailEngine tracks on each sync. "full" - Track every change, including deletions. Slower but complete; "fast" - Detect new messages only. Cheaper, but deletions and flag changes are missed

resolveGmailCategories.description: Automatically detect and categorize Gmail tabs (Primary, Social, Promotions, etc.) for IMAP connections

ignoreMailCertErrors.description: Allow connections to mail servers with self-signed or invalid TLS certificates (not recommended for production)

generateEmailSummary.description: Generate AI-powered summaries for incoming emails using OpenAI

openAiModel.description: OpenAI model to use for text generation

openAiTemperature.description: Controls randomness in AI responses (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative)

openAiTopP.description: Nucleus sampling parameter for AI text generation (0-1, lower = more focused)

openAiMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens limit for OpenAI API requests (defaults: GPT-5: 18000, GPT-4: 6500, GPT-3.5: 3000)

openAiPrompt.description: Custom system prompt to guide AI behavior when processing emails
examples: You are an assistant scanning incoming emails…

openAiGenerateEmbeddings.description: Generate vector embeddings for semantic search and similarity matching

inboxNewOnly.description: Trigger "messageNew" webhooks only for messages arriving in the Inbox folder

smtpEhloName.description: Hostname to use in SMTP EHLO/HELO commands (defaults to system hostname)

notifyText.description: Include plain text message content in webhook payloads

notifyWebSafeHtml.description: Sanitize HTML content to remove potentially dangerous elements before including in webhooks, and fold quoted thread history into a collapsed block

notifyTextSize.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of text content to include in webhook payloads

notifyAttachments.description: Include attachment data in webhook payloads

notifyAttachmentSize.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per attachment to include in webhook payloads

notifyCalendarEvents.description: Include parsed calendar event data in webhook payloads

all.description: Enable detailed logging for all email accounts

maxLogLines.description: Maximum number of log entries to retain per account

imapStrategy.description: IP address selection strategy for outbound IMAP connections when multiple local addresses are available. "default" - Let the operating system pick the source address; "dedicated" - Reuse the same local address for an account, so the remote server sees a stable IP; "random" - Pick a random local address for every connection

smtpStrategy.description: IP address selection strategy for outbound SMTP connections when multiple local addresses are available. "default" - Let the operating system pick the source address; "dedicated" - Reuse the same local address for an account, so the remote server sees a stable IP; "random" - Pick a random local address for every connection

tlsProvisioning.description: Where the TLS certificate for the built-in listeners comes from: "acme" orders one from Let's Encrypt, "manual" uses the certificate uploaded through the admin UI, "self-signed" stops trying to get a real one

tlsHostnames.description: Additional hostnames to hold certificates for, beyond the Service URL hostname. Each one is ordered separately and served over SNI, so a mail client connecting to smtp.example.com is offered a certificate for that name

queueKeep.description: Number of completed and failed queue entries to retain for debugging

deliveryAttempts.description: Maximum number of delivery attempts before marking a message as permanently failed

gmailSubscriptionTtl.description: Gmail Pub/Sub subscription inactivity expiration in days. Empty for Google default (31 days), 0 for no expiration.

locale.description: Default language/locale for the user interface

timezone.description: Default timezone for date/time display (IANA timezone identifier)

pageBrandName.description: Brand name displayed in page titles

imapClientName.description: Client name advertised via IMAP ID extension

imapClientVersion.description: Client version advertised via IMAP ID extension

imapClientVendor.description: Vendor name advertised via IMAP ID extension

imapClientSupportUrl.description: Support URL advertised via IMAP ID extension

exportMaxGlobalConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent exports system-wide across all accounts

gmailExportBatchSize.description: Number of parallel message fetch requests for Gmail export operations (default: 10, max: 50)

outlookExportBatchSize.description: Number of messages per batch request for Outlook export operations (default: 20, max: 20 - MS Graph API limit)

exportMaxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages per export (default: 500000)

exportMaxSize.description: Maximum export file size in bytes (default: 10GB)

name: update_template
title: Update template
description: Update a stored template's name, description, format or content. Send only the fields to change.

format.description: Markup language for HTML ("html" or "markdown"). Leave out to keep the stored value

previewText.description: Preview text shown in email clients after the subject line

name: verify_account_settings
title: Verify account settings
description: Test IMAP and SMTP settings without saving them: connects and authenticates with the supplied host, port and credentials and reports what failed. Set mailboxes to true to also list the folders. Useful before create_account or update_account.

imap.description: IMAP configuration. Set to `false` when there is no IMAP access to configure.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server to retrieve credentials dynamically

auth.description: Authentication credentials for the IMAP server

user.description: Username or email address for IMAP authentication

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (when using OAuth2 instead of password authentication)

secure.description: Use TLS encryption for the connection (true for port 993, false for STARTTLS on port 143)

rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject connections to servers with invalid TLS certificates

disableIMAP4rev2.description: Do not use IMAP4rev2 even if the server supports it

resyncDelay.description: Delay in seconds between full mailbox resynchronizations

disabled.description: Temporarily disable IMAP operations for this account

port.description: IMAP server port (typically 993 for IMAP over TLS, 143 for STARTTLS)

sentMailPath.description: Custom folder path for sent messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Sent" folder. Set to null to use default.

draftsMailPath.description: Custom folder path for draft messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Drafts" folder. Set to null to use default.

junkMailPath.description: Custom folder path for spam/junk messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Junk" folder. Set to null to use default.

trashMailPath.description: Custom folder path for deleted messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Trash" folder. Set to null to use default.

archiveMailPath.description: Custom folder path for archived messages. Defaults to auto-detected "Archive" folder. Set to null to use default.

smtp.description: SMTP configuration. Set to `false` when there is no SMTP access to configure.

useAuthServer.description: Use external authentication server to retrieve credentials dynamically

auth.description: Authentication credentials for the SMTP server

user.description: Username or email address for SMTP authentication

accessToken.description: OAuth2 access token (when using OAuth2 instead of password authentication)

port.description: SMTP server port (typically 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SMTP over TLS, 25 for unencrypted)

secure.description: Use TLS encryption from the start (true for port 465, false for STARTTLS on ports 587/25)

rejectUnauthorized.description: Reject connections to servers with invalid TLS certificates

name: verify_oauth2_app
title: Verify OAuth2 application
description: Check an OAuth2 application against its provider: the credentials, the Pub/Sub setup where it has one, and optionally the connection of one account that uses it.

account.description: Mailbox address used to verify domain-wide delegation and live mailbox access

testConnection.description: Perform the live IMAP/API connection step when an access token is obtained
